1479-5700-5701-7889-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-7889-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

240-5470-6965-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-6965-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2026-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1349-6012-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-6012-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Reluctant Role Model.
When Reluctant Role Model dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Reluctant Role Model from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 6.
Repeat.

728-3240-6462-7422.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3713-4410-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Hermetic Study by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

851-2457-5794-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-3197-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

1494-4444-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-3125-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-5256.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2292-4302-4875.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1169-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

11-2928-4084-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2928-4084-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Part the Waterveil by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Part the Waterveil.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Part the Waterveil spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Part the Waterveil and returning the original Part the Waterveil to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Part the Waterveil from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

396-3179-4050-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 6 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
396-3179-4050-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
When Leonardo enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

1084-1974-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2577-6462-6797.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-6797.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-6797.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3532-4030-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-4030-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2060-2713-5140-5902.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-5902.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

851-1558-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
851-1558-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

662-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
662-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
662-3401-5803.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Kitsa to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-3941-4668-5896.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least six cards this turn.
1031-3941-4668-5896.description:
Cast Coveted Jewel by paying {0} due to Heliod.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {U}{U} due to Heliod.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for Paradoxical Outcome, if needed, and putting it into your hand.
Cast Paradoxical Outcome by paying {U} due to Heliod, returning Coveted Jewel and Invasion of Arcavios from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-891-2523-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
413-891-2523-5515.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

168-372-3204.description:
Cast Mysterious Limousine by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Oblivion Ring to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mysterious Limousine.
When Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mysterious Limousine to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

2-1651-2499-4563.notablePrerequisites:
Everflowing Chalice has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four.
2-1651-2499-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

2648-3008-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2648-3008-4659.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Phyrexian Triniform.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem creature tokens.
Repeat.

2713-2978-4499-5313.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Bookwurm.
Bookwurm enters the battlefield, causing you to gain three life and draw a card.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat.

190-1005-1321.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Mnemonic Betrayal by paying {1}{U}{B}, exiling all cards from each opponent's graveyard.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

2178-4050-4057-4149.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
1 other creature on the battlefield.
2178-4050-4057-4149.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Repeat.

2493-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.

618-2513.description:
Activate the mutated Souvenir Snatcher and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
